data_fields.name: per-tick frame speed (8.8 fixed point, one frame per tick)

best_idea: Pick a creature's clip from a fixed priority list of states, and drive the walk cycle's rate from the distance it actually moved, divided by a per-creature stride constant, so the feet match the ground speed.
decision_why: Keep the priority-list selector and movement-driven rate as client-only creature clip logic, with a ground-speed phase, a per-creature stride, no reverse walk, and no clip phase in server state.
acceptance: Player sees: a creature walking at half its usual speed steps at half the cadence, a stopped creature holds its stand clip, and a death clip plays once and holds its last frame; a server test asserts the kill result is the same with the client clip phase changed.
